summary: US Forest Service lookout on Cajon Pass, built 1935 on a 30 ft steel tower; cab gone by about 1997, tower reportedly down by 2004; sources disagree on the tower.

facts.design: California Region 5 Plan BC-301 cabin atop a 30 foot K-Brace open steel tower
facts.status_note: Cabin and tower reported removed; a survey benchmark remains. One hiking page describes a tower missing its cabin; a 2012 reader comment says the towers are gone.
facts.agency: US Forest Service, San Bernardino National Forest

access.note: Hiking page says a gate is sometimes open and that this cannot be confirmed in advance. No official closure or access notice found.

visit.trail_note: Park at the Cajon Lookout road fork, then about 3 miles round trip on road and cross-country (hiking page).

resolved_conflicts.explanation: A July 1934 item describes a planned lookout site; the register and Peakbagging both give 1935 as the build year. The story reads the 1934 item as the plan, not the finished station.
The register gives 5,319 ft (1,621 m). A November 1945 clipping gives 5,340 feet. The record and story use the register figure.

notes_for_editor: Tower status conflicts. Peakbagging says the 30 ft tower came down about 2004 and only a 1949 benchmark remains. SummitPost's overview describes a tower missing its cabin, and its route text says the lookout is not at the summit. A 2012 reader comment says the towers are gone. The register's 'removed circa 1997' matches the cab date, not the tower; the record has no event for the tower's removal around 2004. Elevation: register 5,319 ft vs 5,340 ft in a 1945 clipping. Access gate status is unverified and no official notice was found. The SummitPost route credit line says 1974. No photos added; Peakbagging photo licences were not checked.
